verdict.rationale: Safe handling of untrusted input is a fair question for a document converter, but the evidence never says that macros or scripts in input files are blocked or treated as inert during conversion. The docs actually describe a macro:// parameter that applies macros from a file. The --view read-only and --safe-mode options are adjacent features, not macro-execution controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the converter treats untrusted input safely: scripts and macros are read as content, never executed
